title: BriLLM-MetaPred: A Representation-Prediction Unity Language Model with Adaptive Self-Measurement
abstract: arXiv:2610.34018v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present BriLLM-MetaPred, the first engineering implementation of the MetaPred machine-learning framework established by a mathematical theory of AGI, instantiated for language modeling. The theory argues that MetaPred is both necessary and sufficient as a machine-learning primitive for general cognition. Taking this theoretical conclusion as a design premise, we report an implementation of the primitive for language modeling. A single continuously evolving dynamical state serves as both the context representation and the state from which predictions are read out. Continuous measurement of its own state reduces finite-depth inconsistency, maintains internal consistency, and provides an endogenous dynamical self-supervision signal in fixed-point form. translated_title: BriLLM-MetaPred：一种具有自适应自测量机制的表示-预测统一语言模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出BriLLM-MetaPred，这是由通用人工智能（AGI）数学理论所建立的MetaPred机器学习框架的首个工程实现，并针对语言建模进行了实例化。该理论论证了MetaPred作为通用认知的机器学习原语既是必要的也是充分的。以这一理论结论为设计前提，我们报告了该原语在语言建模中的一种实现。单一的、持续演化的动态状态既充当上下文表示，又充当从中读出预测结果的状态。对自身状态的连续测量减少了有限深度带来的不一致性，维持了内部一致性，并以不动点形式提供了内生的动态自监督信号。MetaPred的单一动态状态内在地将训练与推理耦合在一起。因此，MetaPred在机器学习的几乎所有关键要素上表现出对称性，一种直观的……
tldr: BriLLM-MetaPred首次将由AGI数学理论建立的MetaPred框架工程化为语言模型，通过单一动态状态统一上下文表示与预测输出，并借助自适应自测量以不动点形式实现内生自监督，使训练与推理内在耦合。
en_tdlr: BriLLM-MetaPred is the first engineering implementation of the MetaPred framework derived from a mathematical theory of AGI, unifying context representation and prediction in a single evolving dynamical state, where adaptive self-measurement provides endogenous self-supervision in fixed-point form and intrinsically couples training with inference.
